description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to acquire the land of Dambagaha watta, Kaduwela D/S/D Colombo District for the Town Development project of Malabe
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a specific development project. It declares that a particular parcel of land is urgently required for the construction of a commercial complex under the Town Development Project of Malabe. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and survey information, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
